messages:
Alex (Support): @Nora urgent: SentryAnalytics trial onboarding stuck at 'provisioning' in us-east-1. Customer has exec demo tomorrow; they mentioned renewal decision depends on success. Logs show repeated 502s from provisioner. Account: sentry-analytics-trial-7.

Nora (CS Lead): Thanks Alex. Can we get a quick triage: quota hit vs stuck worker? Also who can join a 30m call if we need to offer a workaround?

Harper (SRE): Triage: provisioner queue shows stuck worker (worker-12) causing retries and 502s. Short fix: restart the worker and enable hosted_fallback for the account while we clear the queue. I'll run the commands now.

Diego (CS Ops): Drafting comms: acknowledge + explain temporary fallback to hosted, ETA ~20m, offer immediate call with Eli to demo differences and reassure execs, promise postmortem and credit if SLA impacted. Sending to approve.

Eli (Solutions Eng): I can take the call at 09:30 ET and walk execs through the hosted behavior and next steps. Please include a calendar link.

Nora (CS Lead): Approved. Alex please send initial note, Harper execute fallback and restart, Diego send calendar invite. After call, capture RCA and credit recommendation.

Alex (Support): Sent customer note and set hosted_fallback. Harper restart complete; queue cleared. Customer confirmed they can proceed with demo. Closing loop; will add postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
